entries.notes: Every executable TypeScript assertion is translated into 42 Rust tests. Coverage includes prepareCall/prepareStep precedence, abort and timeout propagation, string and structured instructions, constructor/method callback ordering, lifecycle event payloads, tool-call start/finish data, final and detailed v6 usage aggregation, local/global telemetry integrations, listener-failure isolation, and static/dynamic tool approval. The dynamic approval test is split so validated input and no-execution pause behavior fail independently.
